new_findings.title: Missing bearer can block on identity session resolution
new_findings.defect: require_portal_principal declares get_portal_identity_service as an eager FastAPI dependency. That dependency opens get_optional_session before require_portal_principal can reject a missing bearer, so unauthenticated requests wait on database setup first.
new_findings.failure_scenario: With the portal enabled and the database unavailable or slow, GET /portal/me without Authorization enters get_portal_identity_service and its optional-session probe before auth can return 401, yielding 503 or a stall. The integration test test_enabled_mount_resolves_real_portal_and_billing_composition timed out at this request.
new_findings.fix: Resolve the identity service only after bearer verification succeeds, and add an assertion that missing or malformed Authorization returns 401 without invoking the session factory.

summary: Both listed auth corrections hold and their focused guards pass, but the prescribed suite cannot complete: uv could not sync from PyPI and the no-sync run timed out on an unauthenticated /portal/me request before the remaining tests ran.
